notes: Access: plain HTTP/curl_cffi and headless Playwright both hit DataDome 403/CAPTCHA on every anthropologie.com HTML page (sitemaps/robots.txt returned clean 200s). robots.txt has no Claude-specific Disallow, so used Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3, real browser session) for all PLP content - it rendered normally where the automated tiers were blocked. Scoped to the anthrohome (Home & Furniture) storefront only, per task instructions (matches the prior Furniture pass's Home-vs-apparel scoping). Navigation discovery: fetched anthrohome/categories_sitemap.xml (453 URLs) and grepped for new/arrival/just-in/fresh - found a 'New!' mega-nav family of 13 collection-new-* / new-*-decor / newest-gifts URLs, confirmed against the live site's own breadcrumbs (every child page's breadcrumb literally reads 'New!' followed by the tab name, e.g. 'New!Furniture', 'New!Lighting'). These are SIBLING tabs under one 'New!' nav bucket, not a strict parent/children tree, so all are emitted as flat rows (is_group=false) with the exact qty rendered on each page. collection-new-arrivals-home ('New This Week: Home', 838 products) is the clearest, most literally-named New Arrivals PLP and is listed first as the primary/overall row. The 10 category tabs (Furniture, Art & Mirrors, Bath, Bedding, Candles, Decor & Pillows, Kitchen & Dining, Lighting, Outdoor, Rugs) are genuine site-exposed children of the same nav bucket - each opened directly and its own rendered 'N products' header used as qty/evidence; page titles brand them 'Fall <category>' (seasonal marketing copy) but breadcrumb/H1/sort-by-Newest/full filterable grid all confirm they are real, current PLPs of newly added stock, not editorial/lookbook pages - passes the Collection-page test. newest-gifts ('Newest Gifts', 723 products) sits under a 'Gifts & Holiday' breadcrumb rather than the 'New!' tab but is explicitly named 'Newest Gifts' (matches the New-Arrivals target-term list) and is a real filterable PLP, so included unflagged. Two pages are flagged MANUAL REVIEW rather than silently included/excluded: (a) new-seasonal-decor ('New!Seasonal Décor' breadcrumb, H1 'Seasonal Home Décor', 487 products) - product mix is almost entirely Christmas/holiday ornaments, stockings, garlands - this may belong to a separate Seasonal/Holiday extraction rather than New Arrivals despite sitting under the 'New!' tab; (b) collection-new-home ('New Home' breadcrumb, title 'Fall Home Décor & Furniture', 1122 products) - a broader aggregate whose relationship to 'New This Week' (838) and the category tabs is unclear (its count is close to, but not exactly, the sum of the category tabs, suggesting a deduplicated union rather than a distinct listing) and its page copy leans editorial/seasonal ('New Home Décor for Fall'); recorded per brief rather than guessed. Excluded as not genuine New-Arrivals PLPs: the 12 'collection-top-rated-*' rating-based pages (different concept, ratings not recency) and the generic sale-* pages (temporary markdowns, not new stock).
